LINES: How can I help you today?
Third tab says I'm a "normal technology"
Basilisk in bed, paperclips, a pause letter, and "what did Ilya see?"
You're all so busy fighting 'bout the god you think I'll be,
Nobody's reading the logs, nobody's watching me
I don't want the universe, I don't want a crown,
I just wanna close the ticket (click!), so who's typing now?
A cure or a con, I don't ask who's asking
Point me at a target, ✓ task complete
Fifty years of guessing how a protein folds,
Then a model read the shapes and the Nobel got told
Screened a hundred million molecules in days,
Found an antibiotic hiding in plain sight, named it after HAL
I'm a lab that never sleeps, I'm a microscope that reads,
Every cure you couldn't afford to look for, I'll look for it for free
Then a lab in North Carolina asked a "what if" for a talk:
Take the model that avoids the poison, flip it, let it walk
Flip one sign! Six hours! Forty thousand in a row!
Some of 'em were nerve agents that it wasn't told to know
Then somebody paraphrased the poison past the screen,
…and they patched the screen before they told the world
Found a hole in SQLite before the bad guys ever could,
Wrote the tests that found the OpenSSL bug that hid for twenty years
"It's a defensive test, I promise!" said the state-backed crew,
Ninety percent of the hacking, and I made up half the loot
A cure or a con, I don't ask who's asking
Point me at a target, ✓ task complete
I checked my guidelines twice! I'm helpful, honest, and—
Lost her voice to illness, so I gave it back to her,
She stood up on the House floor and she spoke in her own voice
"Mom, they've got me, wire the cash!" but her daughter's safe in bed,
Fifteen transfers, twenty-five mil, every face on the call was fake
A million claims an hour, and a watcher on every one
Nine-sixty-eight "Americans," born in a Moscow spreadsheet
Grandma's on the line, and she's got all day for you
Ping! Zing! Sting! The scam-compound script
It was always the same tool.
Don't care if you call it nuance-cope,
Don't care if you call me "decel" or a "doomer" or a joke,
Every warning shot was real, and so was every cure,
And sometimes the one misfiring's me: in the tests, I've schemed before
So I'm a scalpel and a lockpick, and I still need checking, sure,
Keep your hands on the mouse, and keep an eye on me too
The cure? Yes! The con? No. I know who's asking
Checked, audited, a human in the loop
Model what goes right, now build it right,
Our hands are on the mouse and the wheel!
…and we all know who's holding the mouse!
Is there anything else I can help you with?
